Alex S: FYI — FinServX wants BYO-KMS with a formal key ceremony window and escrow options. They also want explicit billing triggers tied to rotation events. Can we get alignment on what we can commit during presales? :eyes:
Priya R: do we have an SOW template that covers key ceremonies + escrow? they asked for timeline for legal approvals too.
Jordan M: quick Q — are they insisting on a specific HSM vendor (Luna vs AWS CloudHSM) or just FIPS-140-2/3 compliance? also need target TPS for signing/encrypt ops.
Ivy (Sec): we need to run the security questionnaire sections: key custody, split knowledge, rotation policy, audit logs, and access controls. Send me the custodian/approver names so I can pre-fill. :lock:
Devon (Eng-Infra): networking note — if they want on-prem HSM-peering (VPC peering or VPN), we need their CIDR ranges and expected egress patterns. Also any MTU/Jumbo frames constraints?
Alex S: they mentioned "vendor-agnostic but HSM-backed", prefer cloud HSM for speed but legal may request escrow to a neutral HSM vendor. They want rotation window = 7 days max for emergency rotates, regular rotates every 90 days. Billing question: do we charge extra for rotation-triggered rekeying or is that included in Dedicated contract?
Jordan M: pricing impact — emergency rotate often implies rekeying + re-encryption work for cached prefixes. Typically we bill a one-time orchestration fee + extra token processing if we must reprocess embeddings. I can draft two options: (1) included up to N rotates/month, (2) flat per-rotation fee.
kms-bot: Link: https://redwood.internal/sops/sow-templates#kms-key-ceremony — SOW template v2.1 includes sections for escrow, rotation SLAs, and tooling checklist.
Priya R: tagging legal & finance: @Ivy (Sec) can you confirm if escrow clause language from v2.1 is acceptable to InfoSec? @Devon can you estimate infra hours for a typical emergency rotate (cloud-hsm)?
Ivy (Sec): v2.1 escrow language is close but we need to add: (a) key escrow escrow-holder must be audited annually, (b) escrow access requires 2-person split approval, (c) access logs retained 7 years. I'll paste redlines in a bit.
Devon (Eng-Infra): estimate: emergency rotate for cloud-hsm + rekey + rolling caches ~ 12-20 infra-hours for initial POC, then 2-4 hours for subsequent rotates if we automate. On-prem HSM adds network runbook work + pre-flight connectivity tests ~ 8-12 more hours.
Jordan M: sample snippet for the SOW rotation clause:```
Rotation Window: Customer requests emergency rotation completed within 7 days of authorization. Redwood will perform key rotation and re-encrypt affected material. Standard rotation cadence: 90 days. Exceptions and additional re-encryption costs are billed as outlined in Appendix B.
Escrow: Customer MAY elect to escrow keys with an audited third-party. Escrow releases require two authorized signatories and legal approval.
```
Alex S: perfect. Priya — can you propose a pricing band we can show this week? I'd like to avoid open-ended per-rotation surprises for them.
Priya R: I'll propose: base Dedicated fee includes 1 emergency rotation per 6 months; additional emergency rotations billed at $Xk each (covers infra ops + reprocess). For escrow handling, charge setup + annual custody fee. I'll mock numbers and circulate.
Ivy (Sec): for the security questionnaire, we should attach: KMS architecture diagram, audit log retention policy, key ceremony runbook (condensed), and SOC2 + FIPS certs from vendor. I'll compile the redline of escrow text and the questionnaire answers.
Alex S: thanks — can we also confirm if rotation triggers should create an automated billing webhook to customer billing contact? FinServX asked for billing transparency on rotate events.
Devon (Eng-Infra): we can emit a rotation event webhook and also a consolidated invoice line item. Need to add a small scope to billing integration (~4 dev-hours).
Jordan M: one more engineering blocker to call out: cached KV prefixes and embeddings. If customer requires re-encryption at rotate, it may cause CPU token reprocessing; recommend offering a variant: rotate keys for new traffic only and provide opt-in for backfill re-encryption. That affects costs/SLAs.
Alex S: good point. I'll surface both options to the customer (backfill vs forward-only) and ask which they want in SOW.
Priya R: booking follow-up call with FinServX CISO + infra lead for Tues. I'll attach the draft SOW + redline.
Alex S: thanks everyone. Meeting invite sent. :thumbsup:
